map.：算法：棱锥体积 V=⅓·底面积·高（即 A·h/3），与底面形状无关，只要给底: Algorithm: pyramid volume V = 1/3 x base area x height (that is A x h / 3), independent of the base shape, as long as the base area A and the perpendicular height h are given. Requires A > 0 and h > 0. It equals one third of a prism with the same base and height.
map.：例：底面积 A=9 m²、高 h=4m → V=9×4/3=12.000 m³: Case: base area A = 9 m2 and height h = 4m -> V = 9 x 4 / 3 = 12.000 m3. If A = 16 m2 and h = 9m -> V = 16 x 9 / 3 = 48.000 m3 (as with a regular square pyramid of base side 4m and height 9m).

map.底面一定要正方形吗？: Must the Base Be a Square?
map.不必，任意多边形底面均可，只要给出底面积 A；本工具按底面积计算，底面形状不影响: No need; any polygonal base works as long as you give the base area A. This tool computes from the base area, so the base shape does not affect the formula.
map.棱锥和圆锥公式统一吗？: Are the Pyramid and Cone Formulas Unified?
map.统一：两者都是 ⅓×底面积×高。圆锥底面是圆（A=πr²）、棱锥底面是多边形，本: Unified: both are 1/3 x base area x height. The base of a cone is a circle (A = pi*r^2) and the base of a pyramid is a polygon; in essence they are the same, so the same formula applies.
